persona: Mid-level brand and print graphic designer at an agency
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.k@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Graphic Designer, Peacock Brand Studio, Pune (2021 - present)
- Designed festive social media creatives for 12 consumer brands every month.
- Retouched and composited product photos in Photoshop for e-commerce listings.
- Drew vector logos and icon sets in Adobe Illustrator for two brand launches.
- Created logo design and brand identity guidelines for a regional snack brand.
- Prepared print-ready files with bleed and CMYK colour for packaging and hoardings.
- Applied colour theory to clear layouts with strong typography for menus, posters and leaflets.
- Presented concepts to clients and revised designs from their feedback.

Junior Designer, Inkwell Media, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Designed newspaper ads and flyers to tight daily deadlines.

EDUCATION
BDes Communication Design, MIT Institute of Design, Pune, 2019

SKILLS
Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, CorelDRAW, Canva
